prompts.featured: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MEE editorial artwork. Premium tactile paper, stone and crafted miniature illustration with cobalt blue, vermilion red and warm ivory. Sophisticated composition, soft directional studio light, controlled shadows and fine material detail. Wide landscape, essential objects within central safe crop area. No typography, numerals, logos, watermark, collage or chart labels. An imaginary nineteenth century industrial brick mill in cream and red material with cobalt roof and pale gray sculptural smoke on one side of a continuous city diorama; the same river continues toward varied well lit civic buildings and trees with cobalt and vermilion accents on the other side. Nuanced editorial juxtaposition of industry and urban life, not a before and after photograph or promise of universal progress. No text, numbers, logos or real landmark. Landscape for 1200x630 final cover.
